headline: How to Get Magmarex
title: How to Get Magmarex in Aniimo | Lavazar Hot Spring Trick | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Magmarex is a powerful Fire Breaker found around Zephyrus Landbridge. You get it by evolving Lavazar. Raise Lavazar to level forty eight, and make sure you have bathed in a hot spring. Once both conditions are met, you can evolve it into Magmarex. Expect high level wild Aniimo around there, so bring a strong team. Is Magmarex on your wish list? Comment below!
description: Magmarex in Aniimo evolves from Lavazar at level 48 after bathing in a hot spring; it is found around Zephyrus Landbridge.
